svg.text: One C# core for seven save formats.
Desktop · browser · CLI · Steam boundary · in-game companion · doctors · guarded game fixes.
If a structure cannot be rewritten safely, it stays read-only.
Capability gates, backups, fresh hashes and post-write verification protect every writable path.

g.text: read → detect → plan → backup → write → verify

svg.text: Five games, seven save formats, one core.
Detection is based on file content rather than path assumptions. Steam, Proton, GOG and classic installs can be discovered.
A full editor/toolkit rather than one save-file form.
Tools for editing, diagnosis, recovery and in-game control.

g.text: fatal fields · Lua refs · engine signatures

svg.text: Format detection and capabilities decide what the UI is allowed to write.

g.text: the editor preserves bytes it cannot prove it understands
unsupported targets remain visible but non-writable
UI and automation reuse the same format/editing logic

svg.text: Defensive editing: no silent corruption, no optimistic writes.
Unknown / ambiguous structures remain opaque or read-only. Steam Cloud writes require explicit confirmation and are never silently retried.
One .NET core, multiple presentation and native boundaries.
Companion + Game Fixes → shared core/patching layer → atomic game-file writes → ownership hashes / rollback
